secrets.name: JWT_SECRET
secrets.description: Secret used to sign JWT auth tokens for the backend API. Optional: defaults to a dev secret if not provided. Set a strong random string for production.

secrets.name: VITE_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY
secrets.description: Google Maps JavaScript API key — used for the map picker on the Add Property page. Optional: the app boots without it.

secrets.name: VITE_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: Google OAuth 2.0 Web client ID — enables 'Sign in with Google' on the auth page. Optional: falls back to demo Google login.
